d:
With Sukh-E's signature vocals and production, a legendary verse from the pioneer of desi hip-hop Bohemia, and lyrics by Jaani, Jaguar became one of the biggest Punjabi hits of its time — a party and dancefloor favourite that still slaps. Turn it up!
Label: Speed Records
Song - Jaguar
Artist - Muzical Doctorz Sukhe Feat Bohemia
Video - Robby Singh
Produced By - Satvinder Singh, Balvinder Singh (Ruby), Dinesh Auluck & Ramandeep Singh
Line Producer - Apoorv Arora
Executive Producer - Gurdeep Singh
